constraints: Preserve original memos; normalize into separate parsed values.
Use the structured payment method and actual transaction links; memo text does not establish funding or SO/invoice identity.
Keep last four digits as text to preserve leading zeros.
Do not select arbitrary four-digit numbers, order suffixes, dates, amounts or phone suffixes.
Flag missing, conflicting or multiple card candidates for review.
Retain original payment/deposit IDs; brand plus last four digits is not a unique card identifier.
Trace customer deposits through Deposit Applications and count the original funds once.
